description: This file defines the 'EachPromise' class, which manages the iteration over a collection of promises, handling their execution with configurable concurrency limits and invoking callback functions upon fulfillment or rejection. It is part of the GuzzleHttp's promise handling library.

classes.name: EachPromise
classes.description: A class that manages multiple promises, handling their concurrent execution and invoking user-defined callbacks upon their settlement.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EachPromise object with an iterable of promises or values and configuration options such as concurrency, fulfillment, and rejection handlers.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that represents the overall state of the collection of promises, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: createPromise
methods.description: Sets up the main aggregate promise that tracks the completion of all contained promises.

methods.name: refillPending
methods.description: Refills the pending promises queue based on the current concurrency settings.

methods.name: addPending
methods.description: Adds a new promise to the pending list by converting current iterable item into a promise and attaching fulfillment/rejection callbacks.

methods.name: advanceIterator
methods.description: Moves the iterator forward safely, preventing concurrent generator execution.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Handles the completion of an individual promise, cleaning up and possibly refilling the pending promises queue.

methods.name: checkIfFinished
methods.description: Checks if all promises are settled and resolves the aggregate promise if so.
